components.name: 蓝色主动作
components.css: .ds-primary{border:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:40px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:12px;color:#f5f5f7;font:13px/1.6 "Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;box-shadow:0 5px 10px #0005,inset 0 2px 3px #ffffff30,inset 0 -2px 4px #0004;transition:transform 280ms cubic-bezier(.18,.9,.26,1.18),filter 140ms ease;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5b9bff,#2563eb 35%,#1d4ed8)}.ds-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.04)}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.92)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #9cc4ff;outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: 普通动作
components.css: .ds-neutral{border:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:40px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:12px;color:#f5f5f7;font:13px/1.6 "Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;box-shadow:0 5px 10px #0005,inset 0 2px 3px #ffffff30,inset 0 -2px 4px #0004;transition:transform 280ms cubic-bezier(.18,.9,.26,1.18),filter 140ms ease;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a5550,#3e3a36 50%,#2c2926)}.ds-neutral:hover{filter:brightness(1.04)}.ds-neutral:active{transform:scale(.92)}.ds-neutral:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #9cc4ff;outline-offset:3px}.ds-neutral:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-neutral{transition:none}}

components.name: 路径槽
components.html: <nav class="ds-paths" aria-label="编辑路径"><button aria-pressed="true">原样</button><button>美化</button><button>文字</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-paths{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:3px;border-radius:17px;background:#171513;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 5px #0008}.ds-paths button{border:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:40px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:12px;color:#f5f5f7;font:13px/1.6 "Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;box-shadow:0 5px 10px #0005,inset 0 2px 3px #ffffff30,inset 0 -2px 4px #0004;transition:transform 280ms cubic-bezier(.18,.9,.26,1.18),filter 140ms ease;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a5550,#3e3a36 50%,#2c2926)}.ds-paths button[aria-pressed=true]{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5b9bff,#2563eb 35%,#1d4ed8)}.ds-paths button:hover{filter:brightness(1.04)}.ds-paths button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #9cc4ff;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: 美化预设
components.css: .ds-chip{border:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:40px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:12px;color:#f5f5f7;font:13px/1.6 "Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;box-shadow:0 5px 10px #0005,inset 0 2px 3px #ffffff30,inset 0 -2px 4px #0004;transition:transform 280ms cubic-bezier(.18,.9,.26,1.18),filter 140ms ease;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a5550,#3e3a36 50%,#2c2926)}.ds-chip:hover{filter:brightness(1.04)}.ds-chip:active{transform:scale(.92)}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #9cc4ff;outline-offset:3px}.ds-chip:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-chip{transition:none}}

components.name: 浮卡
components.html:
识别与校对

本地 OCR 离线运行；项目保留原图。
components.css: .ds-card{max-width:320px;padding:18px 20px 20px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4a4642,#2a2724);color:#f5f5f7;box-shadow:0 4px 10px #0005,0 18px 36px #0008,inset 0 3px 4px #ffffff29;font:13px/1.6 "Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}.ds-card h2{font-size:15px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.5}.ds-card p{font-size:12px;color:#b7b5b3}

components.name: 校对字段
components.html: <label class="ds-field">可校对的文字<textarea placeholder="输入文字或从图片中识别"></textarea></label>
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:7px;font:12px/1.65 "Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;color:#b7b5b3}.ds-field textarea{width:100%;min-height:100px;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;background:#181719;color:#f5f5f7;box-shadow:inset 0 3px 8px #0007;resize:vertical;font:13px/1.65 "Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}.ds-field textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #9cc4ff;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: 深暖灰凸面动作轨与浮卡承接操作，深色凹面输入区承接校对。顶部高光、底部内阴影和投影塑造触感；截图内容保持视觉中心。
keyCharacteristics: 深暖灰凸面操作、凹面输入。
同一蓝色色系表达动作和选择。
小幅弹性反馈与减少动态效果支持。

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: 主动作和选中态共享蓝色色系，警示色只表达相应状态。

rules.name: The Tactile Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: 操作表面凸起，输入和容纳区域下沉。

dos: Do 延续暖灰渐变、内高光和投影的触感层级。
Do 保留中文标签、可见焦点、独立滚动和减少动态效果支持。
Do 将低频选项收进更多或相关折叠区。
donts: Don't 为三条路径另起文档或视觉外壳。
Don't 用新的强调色装饰普通动作。
Don't 将工具位置或显示缩放写入导出像素。
Don't 将合成预览固化为真实 Windows、DPI 或 IME 验收。
